courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 荷蘭三角洲工程
related.transfer: 可遷移「絕熱溫升與膠結材」與「接縫開度與止水變形」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；荷蘭三角洲工程的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Adiabatic rise and binder heat" and "Joint opening and waterstop deformation" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Delta Works must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦澆塊熱歷程、層面品質與重力壩荷載路徑；荷蘭三角洲工程則以區域防洪網路、環境取捨與分期調適決策為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on block thermal histories, lift-joint quality and gravity-dam load paths; Delta Works centres on regional flood-defence networks, environmental tradeoffs and staged adaptation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「絕熱溫升與膠結材」與「重現期與壽命風險」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到荷蘭三角洲工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「維護組合與風險降低」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Adiabatic rise and binder heat” and “Return period and lifetime risk”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Delta Works, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Maintenance portfolio and risk reduction", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 碾壓混凝土壩施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「絕熱溫升與膠結材」與「接縫開度與止水變形」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；碾壓混凝土壩施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Adiabatic rise and binder heat" and "Joint opening and waterstop deformation" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦澆塊熱歷程、層面品質與重力壩荷載路徑；碾壓混凝土壩施工則以碾壓層密實、材料配比與層間滲流的品質鏈為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on block thermal histories, lift-joint quality and gravity-dam load paths; Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction centres on quality links between RCC compaction, mixture proportions and interlift seepage, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「絕熱溫升與膠結材」與「鋪層體積與供料節拍」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到碾壓混凝土壩施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「層狀滲透異向性」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Adiabatic rise and binder heat” and “Lift volume and supply rhythm”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Layered permeability anisotropy", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 混凝土重力壩分塊澆築
history.text: 重力壩分塊澆築把供料、溫控和接縫安排結合，讓施工階段留下的初始條件成為長期結構行為的一部分。美國墾務局出版重力壩設計專書，提供施工與結構整合背景。 美國工兵團重力壩設計手冊出版，整理荷載與穩定分析。 碾壓混凝土手冊出版，提供不同大體積澆築方法的比較。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。
history.textEn: Block-by-block gravity-dam construction connects supply, temperature control and joints, making construction initial conditions part of the long-term structural response. Reclamation publishes Design of Gravity Dams, providing integrated construction and structural context. USACE publishes Gravity Dam Design guidance for loading and stability analysis. The RCC manual is published, enabling comparison with other mass-concrete placement methods. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.
